name: Class buffs: the Elune's Presence and Protective Roar health cooldowns stack
contract: Maintainer decision 2026-11-22 (PR #13237 review): a buff of five minutes or longer keeps one per stat
across classes; a shorter buff whose tooltip says it does not stack with similar effects is a support buff
and keeps one per stat among support buffs; every other shorter buff is a cooldown, has no CoA class
category and stacks with everything. Elune's Presence 680774 (Starcaller, class 26, 10 seconds, raid
members within 40 yards: SPELL_AURA_MOD_INCREASE_HEALTH_PERCENT base points 19: +20%) and Protective Roar
802782 (Primalist, class 31, 12 seconds, party and raid members: SPELL_AURA_MOD_INCREASE_HEALTH_PERCENT
base points 9: +10%) are cooldowns, so no spell_group decides the pair. Expected: on a grouped ally
Protective Roar leaves Elune's Presence in place and raises the maximum health again.
